description: A white table lamp with a drum-shaped lampshade and a spherical base. The base features an intricate, openwork scroll design, allowing light to filter through and create interesting patterns. The lamp is perched on a simple, round white pedestal. The overall design is elegant and classic, suitable for adding a touch of sophistication to a room. It appears to be made of a material that can be molded into detailed shapes, possibly ceramic or a high-quality resin.
